title: Zestful Zucchini Zabaglione
description: This meal-prep Greek dish is a sweet and crispy delight featuring orange zest, made gluten-free-friendly for all to enjoy.

ingredients.name: Orange Zest
ingredients.notes: Juice and zest separated, use only the zest

instructions: Place zucchini slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Fry the zucchini in olive oil until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, heavy cream, sugar, and gelatin. Let sit for at least 10 minutes before adding zest.
Add orange zest to the cream mixture and mix well. Reheat zucchini slices and place them on top of zabaglione in an oven-safe dish.
Bake for about 3-5 minutes until warm throughout but still crispy, checking every minute. Remove from heat when done.
Optional: Stir flax seeds into the zabaglione before serving for added thickness.
